description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the DataGroupDao class, specifically testing the getDataGroupPermissions method with various filter parameters and user roles within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DataGroupDaoGetDataGroupPermissionsTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for DataGroupDao's getDataGroupPermissions method, covering different user role scenarios and filter parameters.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture, loads test data, and creates an instance of DataGroupDao.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithEmptyParams
methods.description: Tests the behavior of getDataGroupPermissions when no filter parameters are set, expecting an empty result.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithAdmin
methods.description: Tests permissions retrieval for an admin user role, asserting read and create permissions.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithEss
methods.description: Tests permissions for an ESS user role, asserting read permissions but no create/update/delete.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithoutApi
methods.description: Tests permissions for a supervisor user role without API data groups, expecting standard permissions.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithApi
methods.description: Tests permissions for a supervisor user role with API data groups, expecting permissions including delete.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsNotOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all permissions regardless of accessibility, verifying specific data group names.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Tests retrieval of only accessible data group permissions for a supervisor role.
